## Done gate

- [ ] `npm run check` green (+ `test:e2e` for UI, `test:perf` for bundle)
- [ ] `/code-review` run, confirmed findings fixed
- [ ] Docs + open items (`docs/solution-plan/SOLUTION-PLAN.md`) updated; ADR if a decision changed
- [ ] Commits signed off (`-s`), no AI co-author
- [ ] Target: feature → `development`; release → `main`
